name: @some-ui/mobile
description: Capacitor shell that packages www as a sideloadable Android APK, answering its own file_host routes from on-device SQLite

scripts.build:web: cross-env VITE_DEVICE_BACKEND=true VITE_STATIC_DATA=false VITE_BASE_PATH=/ SOME_UI_PROFILE=mobile turbo run build --filter=www
scripts.dev:web: cross-env VITE_DEVICE_BACKEND=true VITE_STATIC_DATA=false VITE_BASE_PATH=/ SOME_UI_PROFILE=mobile SOME_UI_DEV_HTTP=1 pnpm --filter www exec vite
scripts.clean: rimraf .turbo && rimraf node_modules && rimraf android/app/build && rimraf android/build
